step1.title: 1. Create your account
step1.description: Sign up for free in seconds, whether you're a patient or a doctor.

step2.title: 2. Book an appointment
step2.description: As a patient, pick a time and explain your need; as a doctor, set your availability to make consultations easier.

step3.title: 3. Consult online
step3.description: Meet your doctor via video, share documents, and stay followed up.
